# MultiPersonas

> AI-powered accessibility testing that simulates diverse user personas browsing your website.

## What it does

MultiPersonas uses AI agents (powered by Claude) to simulate real users testing your website for accessibility and usability issues. Three distinct personas browse your site independently:

- **Screen Reader User** — Tests WCAG compliance, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, heading structure
- **First-Time Visitor** — Tests usability, information architecture, clarity of navigation
- **Mobile / Slow Connection** — Tests performance, responsive design, image optimization

Each persona operates a real browser (Playwright) and reports findings with severity levels and fix recommendations.

## Key features

- Real browser testing (not static analysis)
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliance checking via axe-core
- Persona conflict detection (when fixing one issue breaks another persona's experience)
- CLI tool (`mpersonas`) and web app

## Tech stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Supabase (auth + database)
- Anthropic Claude (AI agent reasoning)
- Playwright (browser automation)
- axe-core (accessibility scanning)
